scope: read-only declared-license and LICENSE/NOTICE evidence for 22 successful full historical installs
supersedes: historical-dependency-license-inventory-full-22.json; v2 uses corrected pnpm locator parsing for peer suffixes and excludes first-party workspace/file packages.

method.installSelection: IDs marked complete with exit code 0 in the retained historical-installs-preparation.log; exact IDs, receipts, subjects, revisions, and frozen input maps cross-checked against historical-install-plan.json.
method.packageEnumeration: Read each successful install source/node_modules/.pnpm virtual store; decode package locator names, then read package.json and license/notice files from the installed package contents. No package code or lifecycle scripts were executed.
method.researchRule: Do not include or copy .repos research workspace package trees. Local workspace links are excluded from third-party package rows. All external packages found in the full stores are evidence only; no dependency content is copied by this audit.
method.licenseClassification: Retain exact package.json license value and file hashes. The local parser classifies syntax only and does not certify SPDX identifier validity or grant redistribution rights; missing declarations, unrecognized declarations, missing license documents, and unreadable notice files are separate reports.
method.rootNotices: Hash top-level project LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING and first-party THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES files under each archived source root; omit .repos and installed node_modules.
method.limitations: Presence in a full install does not establish that a candidate needs that package. External packages used solely by research workspaces are not identified by dependency reachability here; no package trees are copied, and research workspace source is excluded.
